data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella for 2040? A marbella boat rental hen party budget 2040 starts from just €749 for a 2-hour charter on a luxury motor yacht. That price includes a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and all taxes — no hidden fees. This breakdown covers real fleet prices, capacity, and tips to keep your group on budget while celebrating in style.

Why Choose a Boat for Your Hen Party in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline offers 27 km of golden beaches, hidden coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, and iconic marinas such as Puerto Banús. A private charter gives your group exclusive space, music, and freedom to swim, sunbathe, and party without crowds. With average summer temperatures of 30°C, it's the perfect setting for a hen do.

Marbella Boat Rental Hen Party Budget 2040: Tier A Boats

For groups of up to 11 people, Tier A boats offer the best value. Prices are fixed and include everything.

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax): €749 for 2 hours, €1,149 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): Same pricing as above.

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. For a 2-hour sunset cruise, that's under €85 per person for 9 guests.

Marbella Boat Rental Hen Party Budget 2040: Tier B Boats

For larger groups or a more premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the star. It costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Two variants are available: white and grey. This boat offers a flybridge, spacious sun pads, and a powerful cruising experience.

Other large boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) are priced on request via WhatsApp. Expect to pay between €1,500 and €3,000 per hour for these superyachts.

How to Keep Your Hen Party Boat Rental Budget in Check

Here are five tips to avoid overspending:

  • Choose a 2-hour charter — enough time for a cruise, swim stop, and photos. Extend to 4 hours if you want lunch at sea.
  • Book on a weekday — weekends are busier and may have less availability, but prices remain the same.
  • Split costs evenly — for 9 people on an Astondoa 40 at €749, that's €83 per person.
  • Bring your own decorations — many hen parties bring banners, balloons, and custom playlists. Just avoid glass.
  • Avoid extras like jet skis — unless you book the Mangusta 80, which includes one free.

For €89 per person, your hen party gets a private luxury yacht, drinks, snacks, and a skipper. Compare that to a night out in a club — and you get the Mediterranean as your backdrop.

What to Expect on the Day

Your charter starts at Puerto Banús, where you'll meet your skipper. After a safety briefing, you'll cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, depending on the wind. The skipper will anchor at a calm spot for swimming and photos. You can play your own music via Bluetooth. Most charters return to port 15 minutes before the end time.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a hen party boat rental in Marbella cost in 2040?

Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (up to 11 guests). For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the hen party boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). No hidden extras.

Which boat is best for a hen party of 10 people?

The Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are ideal for smaller groups. For 12 guests, consider the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or Ferretti 94. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we bring our own food and decorations on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and decorations. The boat provides a cooler and storage space. Just avoid glass bottles and heavy items that might damage the boat.

How do I book a hen party boat in Marbella?

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and booking. For Tier A boats (€749/2h), you can book directly online. For other boats, we provide a personalised quote within 24 hours.

What is the cancellation policy for hen party charters?

Cancellations made 14 days or more before the charter receive a full refund. Between 7 and 13 days, 50% refund. Less than 7 days, no refund. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable.

Are there any age restrictions for hen party boat rentals?

No age restrictions for passengers, but the skipper must be at least 18. Children are welcome on most boats. The skipper has the final say on safety, including if guests are too intoxicated to board.

What time do hen party charters usually start?

Most charters start at 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, or 16:00. Sunset cruises (around 19:00 in summer) are very popular. You can request a custom start time via WhatsApp.
